t: You're looking at 190 to 192 Sloane Street, also known as the Sekers Building, a Grade II listed building on the corner with Harriet Street. It was designed by Arne Jacobsen, the Danish architect and furniture designer. He's remembered for his contribution to architectural functionalism, and for the worldwide success of his simple, well-designed chairs. So this is a London address by a figure best known for clean, functional design, which is why a listed building here carries his name.
